name: Iliata
related_quests: An Order Gone Awry: A secretive society named the Ascendant Order has set up operations on Coral Aerie.
summary: Iliata is one of the gryphons trained by Varallion and can be found with him in Coral Aerie. She has dark plumage and a white head, and is described a relatively timid. Varallion plans to breed her to Ofallo. She has lightning-based attacks during combat.
